name: elfura-player
description: Elfura — a small, fast, embeddable HLS/DASH player with multi-audio, customisable subtitles, and a zero-disk uniform TMDB streaming backend.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:embed && npm run build:lib && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: node backend/test/e2e.mjs && node backend/test/diagnostics-pipeline.mjs && node backend/test/roxy.mjs && node backend/test/startup-budget.mjs && node backend/test/selection.mjs && node backend/test/bingr-adapter.mjs && node backend/test/nuvio-adapters.mjs && node backend/test/screenscape-adapter.mjs && node backend/test/vidzee-adapter.mjs && node backend/test/vixsrc-adapter.mjs && node backend/test/vidnest-adapter.mjs && node backend/test/vaplayer-adapter.mjs && node backend/test/vidzen-adapter.mjs && node backend/test/xpass-adapter.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:player && npm run typecheck:backend
